agent.summary:
The `rate` service was crash-looping, and it's now running again. I didn't test the frontend or any request flows. I only checked that the `rate` pod is up.

**Cause:** The `admin` user in `mongodb-rate` had lost its `readWrite` role on `rate-db`. `rate` could log in but got "not authorized on rate-db" at startup and exited.

**Fix:** I ran the existing `/scripts/revoke-mitigate-admin-rate-mongo.sh` inside the `mongodb-rate` pod. It grants `readWrite` on `rate-db` back to `admin`. After that, `rate-7bdc978679-v6cnz` reached `1/1 Running` (3 restarts, all before the fix).

I made no changes to any deployment or manifest.
